query: UPDATE businesses.signup SET identity_attempt = identity_attempt + CASE WHEN COALESCE(CASE $2 WHEN 'text' THEN sent_text_key WHEN 'email' THEN sent_mail_key ELSE sent_letter_key END <> $3, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, code_tries = CASE WHEN COALESCE(CASE $2 WHEN 'text' THEN sent_text_key WHEN 'email' THEN sent_mail_key ELSE sent_letter_key END <> $3, false) THEN 0 ELSE code_tries END, sent_text_key = CASE WHEN $2 = 'text' THEN COALESCE($3, sent_text_key) ELSE sent_text_key END, sent_mail_key = CASE WHEN $2 = 'email' THEN COALESCE($3, sent_mail_key) ELSE sent_mail_key END, sent_letter_key = CASE WHEN $2 = 'letter' THEN COALESCE($3, sent_letter_key) ELSE sent_letter_key END WHERE business_id = $1 RETURNING identity_attempt
